description.value: Liquor Discounter is a multi-location discount liquor retailer serving the Surrey/Fraser Valley area, offering over 1,000 wines, spirits, and beers with a price-beat guarantee on any advertised BC liquor price. The Guildford location is one of three Lower Mainland stores and features a dedicated beer cooler. Touring cyclists passing through Surrey could stop here to resupply on beverages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Guildford location of Liquor Discounter chain at 101-14357 104 Ave Surrey BC, matching the OSM address. The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website and address clearly place this in Surrey — flagged as a concern. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-relevant amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but website and address clearly place this location in Surrey, BC (Guildford neighbourhood) — possible data entry error in OSM.
OSM phone field is empty; phone number 778-293-1964 sourced from website only.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. As a retail liquor store it has marginal but non-zero value for touring cyclists resupplying beverages, but the absence of any cycling-relevant amenity evidence warrants human review before including.
